title: Legendre digit-sum identity for the factorial valuation
statement:
Let $p$ be a prime and let $v_p$ be the normalized $p$-adic valuation of nonzero rational numbers [def-weil-l-adic-numbers]. For $n\in\mathbf Z_{\ge0}$, let $s_p(n)$ be the sum of the digits in the base-$p$ expansion of $n$: if $n=\sum_{i=0}^k d_i p^i$ with $0\le d_i<p$, then $s_p(n)=\sum_{i=0}^k d_i$, and $s_p(0)=0$. Then
$$(p-1)v_p(n!)=n-s_p(n).$$
